description: The build toolchain a Kit project must keep in sync with its kit-kernel pin. SKILL.md Step 2.5 makes updating it a first-class step. Do NOT hardcode versions here — they move per branch; read the target branch's actual pins at upgrade time.

toolchain_files.notes: DEPS_DIR is tools/deps/ or root deps/ — detect it (SKILL.md Step 1).

toolchain_files.holds: the repo_* build tools + template-content packages
toolchain_files.notes: The main toolchain file. Align every package version to the target Kit line's branch.
May be regenerated by a newer repo_man.

how_to_find_target_versions.method: Read repo-deps.packman.xml (and kit-sdk.packman.xml) from the target Kit line's own upstream branch and align the project's package versions 1:1 to it. Add or remove packages that appear/disappear between lines (e.g. repo_nspect is present on feature/main but not on production/110.1 or feature/110.3).
how_to_find_target_versions.reference_source: omniverse/kit-apps/kit-sdk-public (and/or omniverse/kit-github/kit-app-template) on the matching branch. Prefer production/<line> over feature/<line> for a stable upgrade.
how_to_find_target_versions.critical_note: Toolchain versions track the BRANCH's maintenance cadence, NOT the kernel line number. A newer kernel line can carry an OLDER toolchain. Never infer tool versions from the Kit version — read the actual target-branch pins.

example_only_do_not_copy.note: Illustrative snapshot read from kit-sdk-public in 2026 — WILL go stale. Always re-read the target branch at upgrade time.
